text: Cycle 5 of FOLFOX + Bevacizumab. Patient tolerating treatment reasonably well. Developed grade 2 peripheral neuropathy (cold sensitivity, numbness in fingertips). Grade 1 fatigue. No diarrhea. CEA trending down: now 4.2 ng/mL. Recent CT scan (after cycle 4) shows no evidence of recurrent disease, liver surgical bed clear. No new lesions. Plan: Continue current regimen for total of 12 cycles. Consider oxaliplatin dose reduction if neuropathy worsens. Patient maintaining good nutritional status and activity level. ECOG 1.
